rows.label: tlk70000017_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Those huge things really did a number
on us...

rows.label: tlk70000017_02_msg0002
rows.name:
They move so smoothly, you'd
think they were living things
and not machines at all! Hah ha!

rows.label: tlk70000017_02_msg0003
rows.name:
That texture and hardness... Were they
really machines built by someone?

rows.label: tlk70000017_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But if they are machines, producing
and controlling that many is beyond
what humans could ever manage.

rows.label: tlk70000017_02_msg0005
rows.name:
A heavenly power beyond human
understanding... Perhaps that's what
makes it Heaven's Holy Grail.
